source.manualTitle: Samsung Top-Load Washer CG71 Family (WA7000A) (WA55CG71, WA55CG75, WA54CG)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Level sensor hose and terminals
steps.body: Check hose not broken; sensor terminals connected; correct part code installed.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check hose not broken; sensor terminals connected; correct part code installed.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Repair hose routing or replace incorrect sensor part.

steps.title: Frequency check
steps.body: Connect sensor and connector. Measure frequency Blue–Orange — approx 26.4 kHz without water (min 25.9 kHz).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Connect sensor and connector. Measure frequency Blue–Orange — approx 26.4 kHz without water (min 25.9 kHz).

steps.title: Level sensor OK
steps.oemOutcome: Frequency and connections verified — replace PBA if 1C persists.
